snippet.title: Epyx The Games: Summer Edition - Amiga (1988)
snippet.description:
We get to the Seoul of the history of Epyx and Summer Games at
The Dot Eaters: http://thedoteaters.com/?bitstory=epyx

Another Olympic year, another Olympian effort with Epyx The Games: Summer Edition - Amiga.

-~-~~-~~~-~~-~-
View the goofy glitch that makes playing Access Software's classic game Leader Board Golf so much fun: 
https://youtu.be/HnEN942x5rY
